verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail documents in-product AI that works from the user's own data. Ask AI answers questions about the inbox and supports follow-up questions. Auto Drafts pull context from the inbox, calendar and web to suggest replies, and the assistant labels mail and reminds users to follow up. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI insight quality, and evidence of proactive summary or analytic insights beyond Q&A, drafts and labels.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Just ask: _"where is the q2 offsite"_, _"when is my flight"_, _"where am I staying"_, and we'll immediately generate succinct answers.
You can now get rapid answers without having to remember senders, guess keywords, or comb through messages.
Auto Drafts now gather context from your inbox, your calendar, and the web. They can use information from other emails, insert availability, and conduct research online.
If your email needs a response, you’re automatically reminded to follow up—with a draft already written and ready to send.
Emails are labeled the moment they arrive, so you can see what's important and what's not.
